cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4M_HoverEngine_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

R4M_HoverEngine_Housing.mount_port: R4 Robocraft-style port: 0.509 m square, outer face +0.260 m (block face), face-centre coupling
R4M_HoverEngine_Housing.role: static: mount plate, tapered pylon, tripod struts, duct shroud, stator + motor nacelle

R4M_HoverEngine_Rotor.role: lift fan rotor (7 blades): rotates about local Y (Unity up)

R4M_HoverEngine_Vane_1.role: outlet louvre vane: rotates about local X; 0 = closed, 70 deg = open

R4M_HoverEngine_Vane_2.role: outlet louvre vane: rotates about local X; 0 = closed, 70 deg = open

R4M_HoverEngine_Vane_3.role: outlet louvre vane: rotates about local X; 0 = closed, 70 deg = open

R4M_HoverEngine_Vane_4.role: outlet louvre vane: rotates about local X; 0 = closed, 70 deg = open

R4M_HoverEngine_Vane_5.role: outlet louvre vane: rotates about local X; 0 = closed, 70 deg = open

Hover_ThrustGlow.role: thrust glow FX at the outlet - idle scale 0.001

Hover_PulseRing.role: thrust pulse ring FX - idle scale 0.001

Socket_Mount.role: mount face centre on the cell top, normal +Y

Thruster_Nozzle.role: outlet centre; local +Z = exhaust direction (down) -> lift force +Y

GroundProbe.role: lowest point of the pod (hover height measured from here by HoverLiftPod)

notes: Thrust direction: exhaust -Y (down), lift +Y; louvres are visual vanes, not a vectoring mechanic.
